name: AMD Industries Limited
about: AMD Industries Limited provides packaging solutions in India and internationally. The company offers various types of crown caps, including PVC spun, moulded, and dry blend crown caps; double lip liner CSD closures; pet preforms; pet bottles; jars; and plastic bottles. It serves food and beverages, home care, personal care, liquor and spirits, paints and adhesives, pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, dairy, automotive, and agrochemicals industries. AMD Industries Limited was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
